answer: Using ivory, marble, and onyx as metaphors for increasing scale and value, the system ensures that as attackers attempt to create Sybil nodes, the marginal cost of expanding their cluster scales super-linearly, i.e., required capital grows exponentially, far beyond the value they could extract. With quadratic slashing, each additional Sybil node不仅要保证攻击者创建Sybil节点的成本随着规模扩大呈超线性增长，远远超出其能获得的价值，还通过二次罚则使每新增一个节点的风险指数级增加，确保即使拥有大量“ivory”般珍贵的初始资本支持，攻击者也无法负担起“marble”般昂贵的持续扩展成本，最终无力逆转“onyx”般稳固的协议层面共识。
